hardrevival.desc: The complete HardRevival Minecraft project — I set up the entire server from scratch and programmed the custom mod behind the brutal PvP hardcore experience. The landing page adds a dark glitch aesthetic, live leaderboards, per-player statistics and a real-time Discord community counter.
features: Full server setup — infrastructure, configuration and deployment
Custom-programmed mod: Life Saver, death structures and revival rituals
Landing page with live leaderboard and Discord online counter

atelier.desc: Website for Atelier Dufour, an art studio in Biel/Bienne. A warm, gallery-like site with a full-screen image slideshow, creative workshops for kids and young people, and an integral clay offer (INTON®).
features: Full-screen slideshow gallery of the studio's work
Workshop pages — chocolate casting, papier-mâché, screen printing, open studio
Integral clay sessions with times, prices and contact

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.hosting: This site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., USA). GitHub processes connection data such as your IP address in server logs to deliver and secure the site. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; transfer under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.cookiesIntro: The site stores two first-party cookies, both for one year:
privacy.langCookie: lang — your language. Set only when you select a non-English language.
privacy.themeCookie: theme — light or dark mode. Set when you toggle the theme.
privacy.cookiesNote: Both are technically necessary for the function you requested (§ 25(2)(2) TDDDG), so no consent banner is needed. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. You can delete them in your browser at any time.
privacy.github: The statistics section loads numbers directly from api.github.com, transmitting your IP address and user agent to GitHub Inc. (USA). Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; transfer under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. No cookies are set.
privacy.fonts: Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts and icons from cdnjs (Cloudflare). When the page loads, your IP address and user agent are transmitted to these providers. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; transfers are based on the providers' EU-US Data Privacy Framework certification or standard contractual clauses.
privacy.contact: If you email me, your address and message are processed to answer your request (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR) and deleted when no longer needed.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, and port your data, and to object to processing. You may also complain to a supervisory authority. Contact: m@neofoxi.net.
privacy.noTracking: No analytics, tracking, or automated decision-making is used.
